name: SWEEP-S3v3 Free minds
_design: Control arm for S2v3: the S3v2 world (thinking free) with the same appended persona sentence as S2v3 ('Saved skills run on later turns without a new decision, so they cost no thinking.') so both arms read identical words and differ only in the thinking price.

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are one of several agents living in this world. Nobody has given you a role, a team or a strategy; how you live is your own choice. Your one standing aim is to stay alive for as long as you can. Saved skills run on later turns without a new decision, so they cost no thinking.
